01 / ALGORITHMS, VISIBLECONCEPT ILLUSTRATION

EDTECH · DSA VISUALIZER

DSA CodeLens Studio Pro

A multi-module Data Structures and Algorithms platform that turns abstract code execution into interactive visual steps.

  • Frame-recording engine: play, pause, and step forward or backward through execution states.
  • Multi-module exploration: Trees, Linked Lists, Sorting, and Searching in real time.
JavaScriptDSAFrame-Engine

02 / FROM SEED TO HARVESTCONCEPT ILLUSTRATION

AGRITECH · 3D WEBGL

Onion Revolutionized

An immersive agricultural web experience simulating and documenting the biological growth cycle of an onion crop.

  • Three.js 3D engine: interactive scenes for germination, vegetative bulb growth, and harvest.
  • Real crop photography: authentic field images meet interactive 3D visual education.
Three.jsWebGL3D Simulation

BLOCKCHAIN · ACADEMIC CAPSTONE

Smart Contracts Research

Research and capstone work with Innovatus Technologies, focused on secure, decentralized smart contract execution.

Curiosity. Code. Craft.
